Lumakras plus Krazati CMS Part D beneficiaries were 1,527 + 443 = 1,970 in 2023 and 1,563 + 1,042 = 2,605 in 2024 (drug_demand, checked). MULTIPLE 0.4, A JUDGEMENT, the multiple olomorasib and navlimetostat carry: 0.521 x 0.4 = 0.2084
column12: The 0.4 is the arguable figure. Split by product the two G12C drugs took 23.5% and 22.7% of the pool at 55% stopping, or 32.7% and 25.3% at 77.4%, a mean near 26% each while two held the line; iza-bren would be one of at least three new agents in it. Case for more: Breakthrough designation, and a 56.0% confirmed response with a 12.5-month median PFS in chemotherapy-naive post-TKI patients (Hong et al.). Case for less: amivantamab is already given in this line (3 of 40 second lines in the Rafizadeh cohort, where chemotherapy took 30), sacituzumab tirumotecan's TroFuse-009 tests the same comparison and completes in August 2028 (the sacituzumab tirumotecan seed), and first-line osimertinib combinations change who reaches this line
